verdict.rationale: Lindy's routines let users set a schedule or trigger once and Lindy runs the whole job automatically on autopilot, with guardrails deciding what Lindy can do without asking, directly matching event/trigger-based automation. Skills also auto-invoke when a matching request occurs, reinforcing rule-based automatic action. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of trigger types (e.g., webhook, email-received, specific event categories) and confirmation of reliability at scale.
